title: CTRL control / HMI board (two-sided, 4 layers)
note: W2 PCB-CTRL: control / HMI board, two-sided, 4 layers (A-PCB-07). Top: the six TL3145 at the contract switch points, MCP23017 U301-U303, PI4IOE5V9555 U306, the HMI resistors and TVS and the two ENC headers at the cut-outs. Bottom: the THT harness headers (hand-soldered from the top; pin field + 1.0 mm kept free on the top), the Raspberry Pi Pico U305 (its 23.1 x 53.9 mm courtyard does not fit the top between the switch columns and the cut-outs), the buzzer, the LED and the small SMD parts. Iteration 2: scripted LAB5 feed, blower return and fan copper, GND plane vias, fan cluster re-placed. CI/model output of pcb/board_gen.py; not a fabrication release; bench gates OPEN.

layers.source: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup (4 layers, JLC04161H-7628, build/15 "Шари") and pcb/generated/netclasses.json stackup
layers.types_why: In1.Cu (L2) carries a solid GND plane laid before routing and typed power, so the Specctra export marks it (type power) and Freerouting does not route on it; every SMD GND pad has its own scripted via to it. F.Cu, In2.Cu and B.Cu are routing layers; the power classes route on F.Cu/B.Cu only (router.class_layers), as pcb/check_boards.py requires (netclasses.json: no inner copper for PWR3A, 1.8 mm inner for PWR1A).

plan.F.Cu: L1: top parts, signals, scripted LAB5 feed J305 -> J314.2 (1.85 mm) and C342 branch, PWR1A/PWR3A_BRANCH routes, GND pour after routing
plan.In1.Cu: L2: GND plane (pre-route zone, DSN plane), no signals
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signals, PWR3A_BRANCH router branches (LAB5, E3_BLOWER_GND), GND pour after routing
plan.B.Cu: L4: bottom parts, signals, scripted E3_BLOWER_GND rail and E3_FAN5 (1.85 mm), scripted LAB5 islands, locked GND copper over the custom Pico GND pads, PWR1A/PWR3A_BRANCH routes, GND pour after routing

C320.reason: LAB5 branch from the scripted 1.85 mm feed (J305 -> J314.2) to a low-current load: short scripted pieces at D306, C342, C343, U315/C321 and C320/R367/Q304, joined by Freerouting in class PWR3A_BRANCH at 0.6 mm on L1, L3 and L4. Besides the blower (fed by the 1.85 mm feed) the CTRL loads on LAB5 are U315 (limit 0.144-0.192 A, RILIM 162k), the fan switch Q304 (E3_FAN5 0.25 A continuous, tools/assembly_data.py NET_CURRENT via pcb/generated/netclasses.json), the Pico VSYS diode D301 and decoupling capacitors (no DC current): a branch carries at most 0.44 A + the Pico VSYS current; 0.6 mm of 0.5 oz inner copper carries about 0.50 A at +10 degC (IPC-2221 internal, k 0.024), 0.6 mm of 1 oz outer copper about 1.65 A (k 0.048); short-circuit current until the upstream fuse opens is not covered by these widths (bench gate)

cable_exits.why: Between the hole keepouts the left edge holds 91 + 35 mm of header courtyard and the top edge 34 mm (x 6-40); the 13 side-entry harness headers need 173.6 mm of courtyard width, so J310 (S15/S30 to the hatch board) and J311 (S24/S25 to T7A and GNSS), whose segments run in the rear layer, drop to the rear beside cut-out 2. J306/J307 (PHD) overhang the left edge by 1.5 mm so that their second pin row clears the TL3145 column (x >= 9.75) by 1.0 mm; the Micro-Fit pin rows (9.47 mm from the edge) start above SW302. The harness route ends stay provisional until INT refreshes them from connectors.json (mechanical/generated/harness-routes.json "end provisional").

router.why: route run 42423914214 (fan-out on, power classes autorouted) stopped at 60 unrouted connections with 20 DRC errors (dangling fan-out vias, off-centre GND joints, LAB5 with 12 open connections): fan-out off, GND and E3_FAN5 scripted. Route run 43100344071 (34 min): 2 errors (router tracks too close to the custom Pico GND pads 8 and 13, the DSN carries the anchor only) and 8 unconnected (5 LAB5 branches with L1/L4 only): the custom Pico GND pads now carry locked GND copper over their whole outline, and the LAB5 / E3_BLOWER_GND branches (class PWR3A_BRANCH, 0.6 mm) may use L3. Route run 43106410728 with a scripted L3 LAB5 run: DRC errors 0 but 36 of the 3V3_Q6A connections open, because the locked run walled off L3; it is replaced by short scripted islands that the router joins. Job timeout 34 min inside the 45 min CI job
router.class_layers_why: KiCad 10.0.7 exports no per-class layer list; board_gen writes (use_layer F.Cu B.Cu) into the DSN classes PWR1A (F.Cu B.Cu) and PWR3A_BRANCH (F.Cu In2.Cu B.Cu) (Freerouting 2.5.0 Circuit.java / Network.java): PWR1A stays on the outer layers, the branch class may use L3 (branch_exempt, current in its reason)
